name: Solar Binary
description: Two stars of different colours sharing one orbit around their common centre of mass

variations.name: default
variations.description: Half a lap of delay separates the pair, so they swap near and far sides of the plane and each is occluded by the other in turn

props.name: size
props.description: Overall size of the 3D scene in pixels

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the star at the centre of the scene

props.name: trailColor
props.description: Colour of the trail left behind the bodies

props.name: tilt
props.description: Camera tilt of the orbital plane, in degrees

props.name: orbitRadius
props.description: Orbit radius as a percentage of the scene size

props.name: duration
props.description: Time for one full lap, in seconds

props.name: withButton
props.description: Wraps the scene in the AI-agent "Thinking" button shell

props.name: label
props.description: Shimmering text shown beside the loader in the button shell
